## Activity

During March 2023, the clinic team at River Outreach completed 54 captures. This represents the recorded activity for the month. The captures provide the basis for image-quality review and subsequent grading. The activity record should continue to be maintained so that completed work and review outcomes remain aligned.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 10 ungradable captures. This was an ungradable rate of 18.5% of the 54 captures. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate operational process. Clear recording of these issues will support review of image quality and help identify any continuing impact on capture usability.

## Grading

Grading identified 10 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 day. This provides the summary measure for the time between image capture and completion of grading during March 2023. The activity, image-quality, and grading figures should be considered together when reviewing service performance at River Outreach.
